name: Gretel
source:
A timid, withdrawn, and weepy girl akin to a small animal, who tries to convey her feelings through her eyes, facial expressions, and cries. Unable to carry on her story alone, she is looking for her brother "Hansel".

Despite her slender frame, she is a gluttonous, voracious eater. She is often underestimated, but shows bold behaviour when under pressure.

[translated from [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/fairy/index.html]official website[/url]]
